Additional Resources — Nature of Code (notes)

Source: https://natureofcode.com/resources/

Summary:
This page lists ports, books, and papers for further exploration of topics in The
Nature of Code. Key sections:
- Ports of code examples to other languages, including Processing Java, Python
  (pygame, py5), C++ (openFrameworks, SDL), and Go.
- Further reading books on animal locomotion, evolutionary design, generative
  art, fractals, complex systems, neural networks, and mathematics in nature.
- Papers and articles covering evolutionary art, Conway’s Game of Life,
  particle systems, steering behaviors, neuroevolution, and natural form.

Integration ideas:
- Use the port list as inspiration for adding multi-language example references or
  code translation notes in `docs/external/`.
- Add a `docs/external/nature_of_code/bibliography.md` with curated links and a
  distilled reading list for DellMatrix learning pathways.
- Use the further reading collection to enrich `form/mandell/english_brain.py`
  with broader conceptual prompts around evolutionary design, fractals, and
  emergent behavior.
